end.parentNote: Kabir practised estimating 7,204 − 3,869 and 4,982 + 3,015 before checking the exact answer. They worked out that 3,335 is 335 more than 3,000 and 665 less than 4,000. They continued to mix up an estimate with the exact answer, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, ask Kabir to label each result “estimate” or “exact” and explain why the two numbers may differ.
